component.name: Clipdeck
component.summary: Keep a searchable history of everything you copy

description.p: Clipdeck remembers what you copy so you can paste it again later. Press a shortcut, type a few letters to find a clip, and press Enter to paste it into the window you were using.

ul.li: Keeps text, formatted text, images and copied files
Pin clips you use often and sort them into groups
Paste formatted text as plain text
Syncs clips between your computers over an encrypted connection
Skips passwords that password managers mark as secret

description.p: Clipdeck works on desktops that use X11, such as Cinnamon, Xfce and MATE.

ul.li: Sets up the keyboard shortcut on Cinnamon, GNOME, MATE, Xfce and KDE
Installs on Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Fedora, openSUSE and Arch
Available as Flatpak, Snap, AppImage, .deb and .rpm
